subject: Vendor activation: procurement checklist & escalation roster (Fjord Systems)
messages:

Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup + initial support questions

Hi Jonas,

We're ready to move Redwood onto our vendor roster and need to collect the standard procurement pieces so we can raise a PO. Can you confirm:

- A single point of contact for invoicing and remit (ACH/email).
- Standard billing cadence (monthly/quarterly) and typical net terms.
- Any vendor portal or onboarding form we need to complete.

Separately, our ops team asked for an initial support SLA snapshot (uptime targets and P1/P2 response times) so we can map your coverage into our runbooks. I've attached our vendor info template — please complete and return.

Thanks,
Mark

--
Mark Hunter
Head of Procurement | Fjord Systems

Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + initial support questions

Thanks Mark — great to hear. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

- Invoicing / remit: finance@redwood.com (ACH instructions included in our vendor portal). I'll loop in Aditya from finance for the remit details.
- Billing cadence / terms: default is monthly with Net30; enterprise customers can request Net45/60 on contract.
- Vendor form: we have a short vendor activation form and a vendor portal sign-up. I'll attach the completed Redwood side where needed.

Support SLA snapshot (high level):
- Hosted API: target uptime 99.9% monthly SLO; Dedicated deployments often agreed at 99.95% (contractable).
- P1 (system down / critical production impact): initial response within 15 minutes, 24/7 on-call escalation.
- P2 (degraded performance / partial outage): initial response within 1 hour business-hours, escalated to on-call if not triaged.
- P3 (functional questions / minor issues): initial response within 24 hours business-hours.

I'll follow up with a short checklist and a proposed kickoff time to complete vendor activation.

Cheers,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

Jonas — thanks. I attached our vendor_info template (see: Fjord_Vendor_Info_Form.pdf) and a short support questions spreadsheet (Fjord_Support_Questions.xlsx). A few clarifications from our side:

- For PO creation we need: W-9 (or W-8 for non-US entities), vendor tax ID, legal company name, remit instructions, and a copy of the signed MSA or a statement of work reference.
- PO format: our POs use prefix FJ-<YYYY>-<SEQ>, example FJ-2027-0042. Lead time for PO to be approved is typically 5 business days once vendor profile is complete.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood requires a minimum commitment for Dedicated pools (if we choose that route)?

Also — ops asked for a one-page escalation diagram (who we call at 2am for P1, second contact, and SLA credit process). If you can provide that, it will speed approval.

Best,
Mark

Hi Mark — looping in finance and onboarding owners. Below is the vendor activation checklist from Redwood Procurement Ops. Please return the items with the filenames indicated. Once we have these we will create your vendor profile and generate the PO.

Redwood Vendor Activation Checklist (items we require)
1) Completed vendor info form (Fjord_Vendor_Info_Form.pdf) — company legal name, remit address, vendor tax ID.
2) W-9 (US) or W-8 (non-US) — PDF.
3) Signed Master Services Agreement (MSA) or pending DocuSign link.
4) Bank details for ACH (voided check or bank letter) — PDF.
5) Contact roster: invoicing@, security@, support@ (names + emails).

Notes on PO and billing
- Default: monthly invoice, Net30. Please indicate if Fjord requires Net45/60 and supply reason for upstream approval.
- PO numbers are accepted in the invoice reference field. Please put FJ-XXXX on the invoice.

Next steps
- We will send a vendor portal invite (vendor-portal.redwood.com) after receipt of items #1-4.
- Aditya (Finance) will confirm ACH remit steps and will be point for invoice exceptions.

Thanks — happy to stand up a 30-minute kickoff if helpful.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

Mark — attaching a one-page escalation summary and our SLA expectations (see Redwood_SLA_Expectations.pdf). Key items I pulled for your runbook:

Escalation contact flow (summary)- Primary on-call: Redwood Platform On-Call (24/7) — pager + phone, initial ack 15 min for P1.
- Secondary escalation: Support Manager, Monica Patel (monica@redwood.com; mobile: +1-415-555-0198).
- Executive escalation (only if P1 unresolved after 4 hours): Jonas Weber (jonas@redwood.com) -> Cc: Eng Lead.

SLA bullets for procurement use- Uptime: Hosted API SLO 99.9% (monthly); Dedicated can be contracted up to 99.95%.
- P1: 15-minute ack, continuous updates every 30 minutes until resolution or mitigation.
- P2: 1-hour ack during business hours, next-step update within 4 hours.
- Escalation credits: per-contract; we propose crediting prorated service-days for sustained downtime beyond SLOs.

Dedicated commitment note
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) typically require a capacity commitment; we can provide flexible terms for proof-of-concept and short pilots. I'll have a solutions engineer outline options if Fjord wants Dedicated as part of the deal.

Attachments: Redwood_SLA_Expectations.pdf (overview), Escalation_Roster.pdf (one-page).

I'll also open a HubSpot task and attach these assets to DEAL-8723 for your legal/procurement team to reference.

Best,
Jonas
